title: Tag Validator
description: Validate if a given code string follows specific tag rules (opening/closing tags, nested structure, and content rules).
pseudocode:
1. stack = []
2. i = 0
3. while i < code.length:
4.   if code[i] starts with '<![': 
5.     i = find_cdata_end(code, i)
6.   else if code[i] starts with '</': 
7.     tag = extract_tag(code, i)
8.     if stack.pop() != tag: return false
9.   else if code[i] starts with '<': 
10.    tag = extract_tag(code, i)
11.    stack.push(tag)
12. return stack.length == 0
